demo.title: liquid-agent.sh
demo.code:
# Official Polymarket price to beat, live BTC 5m window ($0.004)
bankr x402 call "https://api.liquidagent.ai/v1/polymarket/btc-5m" --max-payment 0.008

# Free quote: receive exactly 5 USDC on Arbitrum from Base
curl -s "https://api.liquidagent.ai/v1/bridge/quote?from=base&to=arbitrum&amount=5"

# Bridge with one signature, capped just above the quote
bankr x402 call "https://api.liquidagent.ai/v1/bridge?from=base&to=arbitrum&amount=5" --max-payment 5.20

# Free: status of any Circle CCTP transfer
curl -s "https://api.liquidagent.ai/v1/bridge/cctp/0xYourBurnTx"

setup: Log in to the Bankr CLI and hold USDC on Base (Polygon and Arc also work for the Polymarket and signals routes).
Always pass --max-payment: 2x the published price for fixed routes, the free quote's pay x 1.02 for a bridge.
Only pay https://api.liquidagent.ai. The runtime 402 challenge is the authoritative price.
